attemptPolicy: One round-wide exclusive acceptance marker, exactly one Chrome startup after successful static preflight. Retain every failure; no accepting rerun.

scope.sourceVM: Execute current emitted ToolRow, imageCardModel/genericImageCardModel, ImageGallery/MessageImage, gallery adapters and label functions against symbolic JSX. Hooks are explicit deterministic stubs; effects are captured, never scheduled. Also execute current bundled image-model functions and singleFit.
scope.browser: Source-derived native image/meta/extra DOM with manual DisclosureRow/TextShimmer shell and local disclosure/retry/lightbox callbacks. Inlined generated 8x8 PNG is a geometry stub, not attachment bytes. No React, host, loader, OS clipboard, hardware input or application launch.
scope.network: File CSP default/connect none, data images only; CDP blocks HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS. Node contacts only its owned loopback debugging endpoint.

limitations: Read-only reference TypeScript locates gallery behavior. Current installed emitted code, dynamic bundles, web CSS and theme are authoritative.

Symbolic JSX executes actual component function bodies with deterministic hooks, without React reconciliation, mounted lifecycle, useEffect cleanup/liveness, loader promises, session authorization or slot registry execution.

Browser bodies and gallery branches come from exact source VM trees; DisclosureRow/TextShimmer containment and local disclosure/retry/lightbox callbacks are manual. Local lightbox DOM is an approximation, not installed ImageLightbox behavior.
PNG pixels are a generated known 8x8 placeholder in data URLs. Synthetic durable metadata drives singleFit; image natural dimensions therefore do not certify real attachment content.
Loading/error/loaded state branches are injected as hook snapshots. Local retry swaps source-derived loading/loaded branches; it does not execute the installed load effect or a real retry.

CDP input certifies only injected trusted events and the fixture local callbacks. No original GUI, physical display, native application or host behavior is asserted. Focus ring metrics are recorded without assuming a width.
